question: Malamin aji na ɗaya zai fara wani sashi game da tasirin zagaye na yau da kullum a kan halittu masu rai da muhalli. Wace tambaya daga cikin waɗannan za ta ba malamin damar gabatar da abin da za a yi aiki da shi tare da ɗaliban?
answer_a: Me ya sa rana ke faɗuwa da yamma?
answer_b: Me ya sa kwanaki suke gajeru a lokacin hunturu?
answer_c: Don gine ginen rana me yasa mutane ke bin al'ada?
answer_d: Me ya sa kake ganin yawancin mutane ke barci da daddare?

question: A cikin fannin Ilimin Kimiyyar Halitta, wani malami ya sanya maƙasudi mai zuwa don Aji na ɗaya: "Bayyana abin da ke faruwa gaba ɗaya da itatuwan 'ya'yan itace a lokutan shekara." Wanne daga cikin waɗannan ayyuka ne ya fi dacewa don tantance nasarar koyon ɗalibai?
answer_a: Ka ba su takarda mara rubutu kuma ka ce wa ɗalibai su zana bishiyar 'ya'yan itacen da suka fi so a yanayi biyu na shekara
answer_b: Ku samar da hotuna iri-iri na nau'o'in bishiyoyi daban-daban, sannan ku tambayi ɗalibai su rarraba su zuwa ga waɗanda ke da 'ya'ya da waɗanda ba su da shi
answer_c: Ka ba da takarda mai zane-zanen bishiyoyin 'ya'yan itace, inda aka nuna lokacin da kowace take ciki, sannan ka ce su yi musu launi
answer_d: Ku samar da katun-katun dauke da hotunan bishiyoyi daban-daban da wasu masu dauke da 'ya'yan itatuwa, sannan ku tambayi dalibai su hada kowace bishiya da 'ya'yan itacen da suka fito daga gare ta.

question: Wani malami yana koyar da sashen nazarin jikin ɗan Adam a ajin aji na biyu kuma yana magana akan manufar fahimtar aikin zuciya. Lokacin da yake binciken ilimin ɗaliban na baya, ya gane cewa wasu suna da kuskuren fahimta game da batun. Wanne daga cikin zaɓuɓɓukan da ke gaba ya gabatar da kuskuren fahimta game da zuciya?
answer_a: Zuciya takan ƙara ƙarfi ta hanyar wasanni
answer_b: Zuciyar mutum girmanta kamar na dunkulalliyar hannunsa ce
answer_c: Zuciya tana sa jini ya ɗauki oxygen zuwa jiki
answer_d: Zuciya ce ke samar da jinin da yake zuwa ga dukkanin jiki

question: Rukunin yara masu tasowa sun lura cewa akwai furanni masu yawa na siffofi da kala daban-daban a cikin tsakar gida. Malamar ta yi amfani da wannan son sani kuma ta gayyace su su gudanar da bincike a kan batun ta matakai masu zuwa: 1. Sun tattara nau'o'in ganyen furanni daban-daban da suka faɗi a cikin tsakar gidan. 2. Sun kwatanta siffofi da launukan ganyen furannin da aka tattara. 3. Sun amsa tambayar malamar: "Me zai faru idan muka saka su a cikin ruwa?" 4. Sun saka ganyen furannin a cikin kwano mai ruwa. Wace fasahar tunani ta kimiyya ce malamar ke ƙarfafawa da tambayar da ta yi wa yaran yayin aikin?
answer_a: gwaji
answer_b: Lura da aka jagoranta
answer_c: Tsara hasashe
answer_d: Kwatanta bayanai

question: Karanta yanayi mai zuwa: Wata malama ta gayyaci yara 'yan ƙaramin shekaru su yi wani gwaji. A cikin wata kwalba, ta zuba ruwa, mai, da sinadarin glycerin. Sai, ta girgiza kwalbar kuma ta nuna yadda mai da glycerin ke tashi sama, yayin da ruwan ke zama a ƙasa. Wace siffa ta abubuwa ce malamar ke nunawa a cikin ƙwarewar da aka bayyana?
answer_a: yawaita
answer_b: Narkewa
answer_c: Dawakiya
answer_d: Rabe-raben Lamba

question: Malami yana yi wa yara bayani game da sauye-sauyen yanayi da ruwa yake fuskanta. Wanne ne daga cikin waɗannan halaye za a iya nuna shi a matsayin misali na takaitawa?
answer_a: Faduwar dusar ƙanƙara a kan ruwan kogi
answer_b: Canjin ƙanƙara zuwa tururi ta sanadiyar aikin Rana
answer_c: Sanyin ruwan teku da juyawarsa zuwa ƙanƙara
answer_d: Jikewar duwatsu da ke fuskantar tururin geyser

question: Malami ya nuna hoto ga yara wanda ke nuna sauyin yanayin abu daga daskararre zuwa gas. Menene sunan sauyin yanayi da malamin yake son ya koyar?
answer_a: Tarawa (ko) Tarwada (ko) Narkewa (dangane da mahallin)
answer_b: Sublimation
answer_c: bushewa
answer_d: Fuzarwa

question: A matsayin wani ɓangare na sashin “Duniya Ta”, dole malami ya bayyana wa yara waɗanne abubuwa ne ke samar da yanayi. Waɗanne ne daga cikin waɗannan abubuwa malamin ya kamata ya yi la’akari da su a cikin bayyaninsa?
answer_a: Yanayi, hazo, da lokutan shekara
answer_b: Iska, lokutan shekara, da yanayin zafi
answer_c: Sillyi, iska, da zazzabi
answer_d: yanayi, iska, da hazo

question: Ka yi la'akari da yanayi mai zuwa: Wata malama tana koyar da darasi game da teku a cikin babi na Halittu Masu Rai da Muhallinsu. Don haka, ta nuna bidiyo inda aka ga teku a lokacin ranar raƙuman ruwa. Ɗaya daga cikin yaran ya tambayi me ya sa raƙuman ruwa suke faruwa. Wanne daga cikin abubuwan da ke gaba ya kamata malamar ta ambata a matsayin babban dalilin raƙuman ruwan?
answer_a: Iskan
answer_b: Ƙarfin jan hankali na Wata
answer_c: Bambance-bambancen zafin sararin samaniya
answer_d: Canjin yanayin zafin teku

question: Wata malamar makarantar yara ta nuna wa yaran wani bidiyon mai motsi da ke bayyana wani lamari da ya faru saboda karkatar da ke kan kusurwar duniyar. Wannan karkata ce ke sa sashin arewa da sashin kudu na duniya su dinga samun hasken rana ba daidai ba yayin da duniya ke kewaya rana. Wane lamari ne na duniya malamin ke ƙoƙarin bayyanawa ta hanyar amfani da wannan kayan aikin?
answer_a: Gudun ruwan teku
answer_b: Lokutan shekara
answer_c: Rana da Dare
answer_d: Kafewar ruwa da cika shi

question: Karanta halin da ke gaba: A cikin rukuni na yara ƙanana, Ignacio yana gabatar da bayani game da kifin clown kuma ya bayyana wa abokan karatunsa cewa wannan nau'in yana samun kariya daga anemone na teku daga masu farauta, yayin da anemone ɗin ma ke samun kariya saboda kifin yana korar wasu kifaye masu farautarta. Malamar ta shiga tsakani don ta bayyana musu menene sunan irin dangantakar halittu da yaron ya bayyana. Wace irin dangantakar halittu ce malamar ya kamata ta ambata a cikin bayanin nata?
answer_a: Cushe-zama-da-yawa
answer_b: Amensalizim
answer_c: Bangaranci
answer_d: Tsarin Hulɗa Mai Amfani Ga Juna

question: Malami yana so ɗalibansa su fahimci ma'anar alkiblar kibau a cikin sarƙoƙin abinci. Wane abu ne ya kamata ɗalibai su fahimta don cimma burinsu?
answer_a: Pyramids na adadin halittu a cikin tsarin halittu
answer_b: Dangantakar tsakanin nau'o'i daban-daban
answer_c: Masu amfani na farko da na biyu
answer_d: Raguwa da kiyayewar makamashi

question: A cikin sashin tsarin zagayawar jini, wani malami yana aiki a kan wasu ci gaban fasaha, kamar na'urorin bugun zuciya, domin ɗalibansa su fahimci yanayin canzawa da kuma yanayin gama gari na kimiyya. Wace daga cikin ayyukan da ke biyo baya ce ta kauce daga manufar da malamin yake so ɗalibansa su cimma?
answer_a: Ƙirƙiri samfurin na'urar sarrafa bugun zuciya a cikin ƙungiyoyi, bin wani tsari da aka ayyana kuma aka inganta.
answer_b: Yi bincike a kan juyin halittar na'urorin bugun zuciya (pacemakers) sannan ka tsara takardar bayanai
answer_c: A haɓaka wani faifai na bayani da zai ba da labari kan sabbin ci gaba a na'urorin bugun zuciya
answer_d: Tsara jadawalin lokaci da ya haɗa da masana kimiyya da suka ba da gudummawa ga ilimin da ake da shi yanzu game da na'urorin bugun zuciya

question: Malamar tana son ɗalibanta su fahimci tsarin kumburi a matsayin wani ɓangare na rigakafin halitta. Waɗanne ra'ayoyi na gaba ne ya kamata ɗaliban su sani don cimma wannan manufar?
answer_a: Makirofajis suna gabatar da antigens ga T-limfosaitis
answer_b: Nirofils na yi fagosaitis ga nau'o'i daban-daban na kwayoyin cuta masu hadari
answer_c: Kwayoyin T lymphocytes waɗanda suke maƙasudin wani takamaiman antijen suna ninka kansu
answer_d: B lymphocytes suna rikiɗa zama kwayoyin plasma waɗanda ke fitar da antibodies

question:
Manufar malami ita ce ɗalibai su yanke hukunci game da alaƙar da ke tsakanin aikin tsarin narkar da abinci da buƙatun abinci mai gina jiki na ƙwayoyin halitta.

Waɗanne daga cikin ayyukan tantancewa na gaba ne za su taimaka wajen tabbatar da cewa ɗaliban sun cimma wannan manufa?
answer_a: Ƙaddamar da wata hasashe don gano dangantaka tsakanin lipases da lipids
answer_b: Ku shirya gwaji kan aikin amylase da ke cikin yau a kan carbohydrates
answer_c: Bincika ma'aunin gwaji kan aikin pepsin a kan sunadarai
answer_d: Bincika zane game da canjin sukarin jini bayan cin abinci mai ɗauke da sinadarin 'carbohydrates'

question: Farfesa na aiki a kan sashin tsarin narkar da abinci kuma yana so ya bayyana rawar da ƙwayoyin cuta ke takawa a jikin ɗan adam. Wanne ne daga cikin zaɓuɓɓuka masu zuwa ya yi daidai da rashin fahimtar ɗalibai game da ƙwayoyin cuta?
answer_a: Probiotics sun dace da kwayoyin cuta
answer_b: Kwayoyin cuta na da illa ga rayayyun halittu
answer_c: Ƙwayoyin halittu na hanji suna sauƙaƙa shanyewar sinadaran abinci a cikin hanji
answer_d: Kwayoyin rigakafi na kashe kwayoyin cuta masu illa da masu amfani ga jiki

question: Malamar tana so ɗalibanta su gabatar da ra'ayoyi masu tushe a kan wasu aikace-aikacen ilimin ilimin halittar ƙwayoyin halitta (cell biology). Wanne daga cikin ayyukan da ke gaba zai bai wa malamar damar cimma burinta?
answer_a: Gabatarwa da ke nuna canje-canjen da dabarun kilona suka samu
answer_b: Shiryawa ko ƙirƙirar wani hoto-fosta a kan dabarun samar da halittu masu canjin kwayoyin halitta (transgenic organisms)
answer_c: Bincike na ka'ida game da jiyya ta kwayoyin halitta a maganin cututtuka
answer_d: Makala kan amfani da ƙwayoyin halitta na asali wajen magance cututtuka

question: Malami yana da buri ga ajinsu cewa ɗalibansu su fahimci tsarin janyewar ruwa (plasmolysis) ta hanyar gwaji. Wanne ne daga cikin waɗannan gwaje-gwajen ya kamata waɗannan ɗalibai su gudanar don samun ci gaba wajen fahimtar wannan tsari?
answer_a: A jika dankali guda, da aka riga aka daka a cikin ruwan gishiri, na tsawon sa'o'i biyu, sannan a sake daka shi.
answer_b: A jiƙa ɗan naman da aka riga aka daka a ruwan gishiri na tsawon awa biyu, sannan kuma a sake dakashi
answer_c: Jikà karas da aka riga aka latsa a cikin ruwan da aka tace na tsawon kwana biyu, kuma a sake latsashi bayan an cire shi daga ruwan
answer_d: A jika kwai wanda aka cire bawon sa a cikin ruwa mai tsafta, sannan a lura da canjin girma bayan kwanaki uku

question: Malami na son tantance manufar koyo mai zuwa: Bayyana cewa halittu masu rai sun kunshi kwayoyin halitta guda ɗaya ko fiye kuma an tsara waɗannan cikin kyallen jiki, gabobi, da tsarin jiki. Wane daga cikin alamomin koyo na ɗalibi masu zuwa ne yake da alaƙa kai tsaye da manufar da za a tantance?
answer_a: Suna kwatanta kyallen jiki na salula (cellular tissues) na tsare-tsare daban-daban (different systems) a jikin ɗan Adam
answer_b: Suna fahimtar cewa kowace ƙwayar halitta tana fitowa ne daga wata ƙwayar halitta da take a baya
answer_c: Suna kafa alaƙa tsakanin matakai daban-daban na tsarin halittu na jikin dabbobi da mutane (organism)
answer_d: Suna danganta tsakanin kasancewa da yawan tsarin sel (cellular structures) da ayyukan sel (functions of the cell)

question: Dangane da rukunin darasi game da ilimin motsin farfajiyar ƙasa da dangantakarsa da motsin nahiyoyi, afkuwar girgizar ƙasa, da wanzuwar aman wuta, da sauransu, wata malama tana so ɗalibanta su fahimci cewa kimiyya wani tsari ne mai motsi da haɗin gwiwa akan lokaci. Wacece daga cikin ayyukan nan ya kamata ta umurci ɗalibanta su yi a matsayin wani ɓangare na bincike don cimma burinta?
answer_a: Yi nazarin shaidun da ke goyon bayan plate tectonics
answer_b: Bincika yadda aka gina tsarin ka'idar tectonics ta faranti
answer_c: Bayyana dalilin da ya sa ake kiransa ka'idar motsawar faranti
answer_d: Bincika canje-canjen da suka faru a ɓawon duniya saboda yanayin faifai (plate tectonics)

question: Wani malami ya tsara ayyuka masu zuwa don sashin koyo da ya shafi tsarin kwayar halitta (atomic structure): 1. Dalibai za su karanta su kuma bincika wani rubutu game da samfurin kwayar halitta na yanzu da kuma manyan halayensa. 2. Dalibai za su warware yanayin matsaloli game da tsarin kwayar halitta da abubuwan da suka kafa ta, tsarin lantarki (electronic configuration) dinta, da kuma lambobin quantum dinta. 3. Dalibai za su tattauna a cikin kungiyoyi game da wani rubutu game da juyin halittar samfurin kwayar halitta da kuma manyan halayensa tare da zane-zane masu wakiltar kowane ɗayan (Democritus, Dalton, Thomson, Rutherford, Bohr). 4. Dalibai za su yi kwatankwacin samfuran kwayar halitta daban-daban suna nuna manyan halayensu. Wace ce daga cikin jerin wadannan ayyukan ke inganta koyo mai ci gaba wajen fahimtar tsarin kwayar halitta?
answer_a: Huɗu - Uku - Biyu - Ɗaya

question: A cikin ajin "Zafi," malama tana so ɗalibanta su fahimci ra'ayin zafin jiki. Waɗanne abubuwan koyo ne ke wajaba a sani tun farko don cimma wannan burin?
answer_a: Ƙarfin kuzarin motsi
answer_b: Koyaushewar zafi
answer_c: fadada mai zafi
answer_d: Ma'aunan zafin jiki

question: Marcial ya karantawa ɗalibansa wannan yanayi mai zuwa: Wani mutum yana dafa taliya don iyalinsa. Ya tafasa ruwa a tukunya sannan ya zuba taliyar a cikin tukunyar. A cewar umarnin da ke kan kunshin taliyar, ya kamata ya rage harshen wuta, amma saboda yana sauri, sai ya bar wutar da ƙarfi domin ya ce ta hakan ruwan zai yi zafi sosai kuma za su dahu da sauri. Lokacin da suke tattauna ra'ayoyinsa game da wannan yanayi, mafi yawansu sun yarda da abin da mutumin ya yi. Wace irin aiki ce Marcial ya kamata ya ba ɗalibansa domin ya kalubalanci ra'ayoyinsu na farko?
answer_a: Don bincika yadda wurin tafasar ruwa ke canzawa a ƙarƙashin yanayin muhalli daban-daban
answer_b: Don auna lokacin da mililita 200 na ruwa ke ɗauka kafin su ƙafe a cikin gilashin da aka dora su kan wuta masu ƙarfi daban-daban
answer_c: Don gabatar da wata hanya don nazarin bambancin zafin tafasa a matsayin aikin adadin ruwan da aka ɗumama
answer_d: Don a ɗumi ruwa a cikin kwano (beaker) har sai ya tafasa, ƙara tsananin wutar, kuma a auna zafin kowane daƙiƙa talatin na tsawon minti huɗu

question: Burin malam shi ne dalibansa su tsara wani bincike na gwaji dangane da ƙarfin gogayya. Don haka, yana da tubala masu fuskoki iri-iri (silele, da takardar yashi, da soso, da ƙarfe) da kuma teburin da za a iya karkatarwa. Dalibai sun lura cewa idan aka dora tubalin a kan tebur aka karkatar da shi, a wani mataki na karkata, tubalin zai fara zamiya. Wace aiki a cikin waɗannan da ke tafe za ta ba wa malamin damar tantancewa zuwa wane mataki ɗalibansa suka cimma burin da aka faɗa?
answer_a: Ku tambayi ɗalibai su gano ma'adanai (variables) na gwajin kuma su ƙayyade hanyar rubuta bayanai (data recording)
answer_b: Bawa ɗalibai littafin jagora don aiki don auna kusurwar da kowane bulo ya fara zamewa da kuma lissafa matsakaici don ma'auni uku a kowane bulo
answer_c: Gaya wa ɗalibai su ajiye kowane tubali a wuri kafaffe kuma su karkatar da teburin har sai tubalin ya zamewa, sannan su auna kusurwar daga inda ya fara zamewa.
answer_d: Ka umarci ɗalibai su gano matakan da za su bi don kafa wata dangantaka mai yiwuwa tsakanin saman katangar da kuma kusurwar da ta fara zamewa

question: Malami yana so ya gudanar da aikin bincike jagorance tare da dalibansa, don su fahimci cewa shaidar gwaji ginshiki ce wajen gina ilimi. Idan malamin ya so ya auna cimma wannan manufa, wace daga cikin alamun tantancewa za ta ba shi damar yin hakan kai tsaye?
answer_a: Suna fassara bayanan gwaji-gwajin da aka samu a matakin gwaji
answer_b: Suna rubuta shaidar da suka samu a matakin gwaji na binciken.
answer_c: Suna tsara ƙarshe-ƙarshen da suke danganta shaidar empirika da tambayar bincike da aka yi
answer_d: Suna tsara wani gwaji da zai ba su damar samun hujjojin gwaji don amsa tambayar binciken

question: Karanta makasudin koyo mai biyo baya: Ka bincika kuma ka fassara bayanai domin samar da shaida da ke goyon bayan ra'ayin cewa bambancin halittu sakamako ne na Juyin Halitta. Wanne daga cikin waɗannan ayyukan ɗalibi ne ke da alaƙa kai tsaye da cika makasudin koyon?
answer_a: Rarraba halittu dabam-dabam bisa ga ma'auni na rarraba halittu
answer_b: Danganta wanzuwar burbushin halittu a wasu layukan ƙasa da yanayin da ya gabata da na yanzu
answer_c: Duba, daga rubuce-rubucen burbushin halitta daban-daban na wata halitta, halayen wannan jinsin
answer_d: Kwatanta tsokoki masu kama da juna a nau'ukan halittu daban-daban, kamar kafadaren kifi mai-ruwa (whale) da fiffiken jemage

question: Idan malami yana so ya bayyana wa ɗalibansa manufar haɗin kai na farko, wane ne daga cikin waɗannan misalai zai iya amfani da shi don bayyanar tasa?
answer_a: Tsuntsun Takala na Afirka yana da kwari masu yawa a cikin salonsa, wadanda suke cin kazanta; ta haka, suna tsaftace sharar da ke taruwa a cikin salo
answer_b: Dabbobi masu taunar gyro suna da bacteria a cikin hanjinsu wadanda ke iya sarrafa cellulose, ta yadda wannan sinadarin abinci zai kasance mai amfani ga duka biyun
answer_c: Furen orchid suna manne wa itatuwa don samun isasshen haske, ruwa, da ma'adanai, ba tare da sun ɗauke su daga itacen ba, kuma hakan ba ya shafar itacen ko kaɗan
answer_d: Kwayoyin cuta na Rhizobium suna samun abubuwan gina jiki da suke buƙata daga saiwoyin legum, kuma a sakamakon haka, kwayoyin cuta suna gyara nitrogen da waɗannan tsire-tsire ke buƙata

question: Malam ya nemi ɗalibansa su yi nazari kan yanayin gwaji mai zuwa don tantance ko sun gane abubuwan da ke sarrafa aikin sarrafa abinci na shuka (photosynthesis): A cikin wani wuri rufaffe, ba tare da tagogi ba kuma a zafin jiki mai tsayayye, an ajiye shukoki guda biyu (A da B) a gefe guda guda na ɗakin. An haska shuka A da haske kore kuma shuka B da haske shuɗi. An shayar da su duka da adadin ruwa iri ɗaya sau ɗaya a mako. Sannan ya tambaye su su amsa tambaya mai zuwa: A wacce daga cikin shukokin biyu ne ake sa ran za a ga girma mafi girma? Wacce daga cikin amsoshin da za a bayar ce za ta bai wa malamin damar gane cewa an cimma manufar koyon?
answer_a: Shuka A na yin girma fiye saboda kwayoyin haske kore (green photons) suna ɗaukar kuzarin haske fiye da kwayoyin haske shudi (blue photons)
answer_b: Shuka B na girma sosai saboda shudin haske na iya shiga cikin chlorophyll da yawan gaske fiye da koren haske
answer_c: Babu ko ɗaya daga cikin tsirran da ke girma domin duk da suna da wadatar ruwa, kasancewarsu a rufe, ba su da wadatar CO2
answer_d: Shuke-shuken biyu suna girma iri ɗaya saboda suna da wadatar ruwa mai yawa, wanda ke ba su damar buɗe stomata ɗin su ba tare da matsala ba don CO2 ta shiga

question: Malamar ta gabatarwa ɗalibanta da wannan gwajin gwaji da ya shafi dangantakar antigen-antibody: Wane tunani na farko da ba daidai ba ne ke ba da damar kawar da wannan hanyar gwaji?
answer_a: Kwayoyin B suna samar da rigakafin da ba su keɓance ba
answer_b: Antigen suna dacewa da nau'in antibody guda ɗaya kawai
answer_c: rigakafi na iya yin hulɗa da kowane nau'in ƙwayoyin cuta
answer_d: Kwayoyin B lymphocytes suna samar da nau'ikan rigakafi daban-daban lokacin da suka sadu da nau'i ɗaya na antigen

question: A cikin tsarin shirya darasi game da tsarin Endokrin, wane abu ne daga cikin waɗannan ya zama dole ɗalibanka su sani tun farko domin su iya bambance yadda homonai ke fara martani a cikin kwayar halitta mai karɓa?
answer_a: Abubuwan Fitar da Hormone
answer_b: Siffar sinadarin Hormones
answer_c: Daidaita hormons a sanadin ruwan jiki
answer_d: Tsarin martani na kwayoyin halitta (hormones)

question: A cikin kimantawa ta ƙarshe, Malamin Ilimin Halittu ya haɗa da tambaya mai zuwa: ‘Wane irin canje-canjen aiki na jiki za a lura da su a cikin mace da aka yi mata allura da magani wanda ke hana aikin GnRH? Bayyana su.’ Wace daga cikin waɗannan manuniya ta kimantawa ce ake maganinta ta hanyar abin da aka tsara?
answer_a: Kwatanta aikin homon da ke da alhakin sauye-sauyen balaga
answer_b: Bayyana sarrafawar hormonai na hypothalamic a kan zagayen ƙwai da na mahaifa
answer_c: Bayyana jerin abubuwan da ke faruwa a cikin zagayowar al'adar mace (ovarian cycle) dangane da lokacin kwayayen da ke girma (follicular phase), lokacin fitowar kwaya (ovulation), da kuma lokacin corpus luteum (luteal phase)
answer_d: Bayyana tsarin abubuwan da ke faruwa a tsarin kwayayen mahaifa (uterine cycle) dangane da haila, lokacin girma (proliferative phase), da lokacin ɓoyayyen abu (secretory phase)

question: A lokacin darasin da ya shafi kwayoyi, wata malama tana son ɗalibanta su haɓaka ikon gano abubuwan canzawa (variables) na wani bincike. Wane aikin auna nasara ne zai ba wannan malamar damar auna cimmar burin da aka faɗa?
answer_a: Gine-ginen matatar sigari don tantance abubuwa masu guba a cikinta
answer_b: Tsare-tsaren sakamako na wani bincike da ɗalibai suka shirya kan abubuwan da ke shafar fara shan barasa da wuri
answer_c: Tsara Tsarin Nazari a kan bincike da ya shafi dalilan shan wiwi a cikin matasa
answer_d: Gina samfurai da ɗalibai suka yi a kan yadda magungunan ƙara kuzari ke aiki a matakin mahadar sinadarai (chemical synapses)

question: Malama tana so ɗalibanta su fahimci kimiyya a matsayin wani tsari mai gudana na gina ilimi. Don cimma burinta, ta ce wa ɗalibanta su ƙirƙiri jerin lokaci a ƙungiyance, yana nuna gudunmawar waɗannan masana kimiyya: Friedrich Miescher, Robert Feulgen, P. A. Levene, Frederick Griffith, Oswald Avery, Alfred D. Hershey, da Martha Chase. Wanne daga cikin waɗannan ayyukan koyo na ɗalibai ne yake da muhimmanci don nuna ci gaban wannan ilimin?
answer_a: Fassara hotuna da ke nuna matakai daban-daban na zagayowar tantanin halitta
answer_b: Bayyana matakan tafiyar bayanan kwayoyin halitta, tun daga kwayar halitta (gene) zuwa sinadarin gina jiki (protein)
answer_c: Yi bayanin tsarin kwayar halitta ta DNA da dangantakarsa da ninka (replication) da sauya (transcription)
answer_d: Fassara gwaje-gwaje da ke nuna DNA a matsayin kwayar halittar da ke ɗauke da bayanan asali na rayuwa

question:
Malami yana so ɗalibansa su gano sauye-sauyen kwayoyin halitta waɗanda ke tsara yaɗuwar tantanin halitta da bambancin ta a cikin cutar kansa. Don yin haka, ya tsara ayyuka masu zuwa don ɗalibansa su kammala:
1. Gina tsarin zagayowar tantanin halitta da wuraren sarrafa ta.
2. Gane ra’ayoyin yaɗuwar tantanin halitta da bambancin ta ta amfani da wasan ƙwaƙwalwa (puzzle).
3. Haɗa alaƙar shigar muhimman kwayoyin halitta a sarrafa zagayowar tantanin halitta da kuma a nau’ikan cutar kansa daban-daban.
Wanne daga cikin zaɓuɓɓuka masu zuwa ne zai zama ci gaba daga mai sauƙi zuwa mai rikitarwa na ayyukan da aka ambata don cimma manufar koyo?
answer_b: 1 zuwa 3 zuwa 2
answer_c: Biyu – Daya – Uku

question: A cikin ajin lantarki na babbar makarantar sakandare, wata malama ta yi wa ɗalibanta tambaya mai zuwa: "Wace ce a cikin fitilu biyun kuke tsammanin za ta fi ba da haske?" A sakamakon haka, dukkan ɗalibanta sun amsa cewa ƙarfin hasken fitila B zai fi na fitila A yawa. Bayan haka, malamar ta ba da shawarar cewa su tabbatar da hasashensu ta hanyar gwaji kuma su tattauna sakamakon da aka samu, inda za su kwatanta su da ra'ayoyinsu da fahimtarsu na asali. Dangane da abin da ke sama, menene manufar aiki na biyu da malamar ta gabatar?
answer_a: Don ba da rikici na sani da motsa sauyin tunani a cikin ɗalibai
answer_b: Don auna koyon ɗalibai dangane da aikin na'urorin lantarki
answer_c: Don A gane ra'ayoyin ɗalibai na farko da suka danganci yadda sirkui ke aiki
answer_d: Don gano dalilan kuskuren fahimta da ɗalibai suka nuna a aiki na farko

question: A matsayin wani ɓangare na darasin “Haske da Ilmin Kayyakin Haske (Geometric Optics),” malami yana buƙatar tsara wata ayyuka bisa ga manufa mai zuwa: “A binciki samfurin ƙwayoyin haske (corpuscular model) sosai don bayyanawa da kuma fassara al’amuran haske, a fahimci cewa samfuran suna da fa’idodi kuma a lokaci guda suna da iyakoki.” Wacece a cikin ayyukan nan masu zuwa za ta ba wa ɗalibai damar yin aiki a kan manufar da aka bayyana?
answer_a: Bincika kwatancen raƙatar haske a cikin ɗan rami da siffar rarrabewarsa (polarization) a lokacin da ya ratsa ta cikin ma'aurata biyu na raba haske (polarizers), ta amfani da tsarin ƙwayoyin haske (corpuscular model of light)
answer_b: Bincika a kwatance yadda hasken rana ke nunawa a madubi da kuma tarwatsewar haske a madaidaiciya biyu, ta amfani da samfurin kwayar halitta na haske
answer_c: Bincika, ta hanyar kwatanci, yadda hasken rana ke karyewa yayin da ya ratsa ta cikin gilashi da yadda hasken rana ke dawowa yayin da ya haskawa madubi, ta amfani da samfurin kwayar halitta na haske (corpuscular model)
answer_d: Binciko kwatankwacin yadda hotuna ke samuwa a madubai masu lankwasa da kuma a ruwan tabarau masu lankwasa ciki, ta amfani da ka'idojin ilmin hangen nesa na lissafi, ta hanyar tsarin nau'in zarra na haske

question: Malami tana aiki tare da ɗalibanta kan tsarin duniya a tsakiya (geocentric model) wanda Ptolemy ya gabatar kuma tana son gudanar da wani aiki wanda zai ba su damar fahimtar yadda tsarin rana a tsakiya (heliocentric model) na Copernicus ya fito daga sukar tsarin duniya a tsakiya. Wanne daga cikin ayyukan da ke gaba zai baiwa malamar damar cimma wannan manufa?
answer_a: Ka umarci ɗalibai su kwatanta, su gano kamance-kamance da bambance-bambance, tsarin Ptolemy da na Copernicus don bayyana Tsarin Rana
answer_b: Nuna wa ɗalibai kwaikwayon na'ura mai kwakwalwa da ke wakiltar motsin Rana da taurari, bisa ga ra'ayoyin geocentric da heliocentric
answer_c: Ku nuna wa ɗalibai bidiyon koma-bayan motsin wata duniyar, don su bayyana abin da suka lura da shi bisa ga tsarin samaniya na Geocentric da na Heliocentric na Tsarin Rana
answer_d: A gabatar wa ɗalibai, daga mahangar tarihi, illolin abin da ake kira "Juyin Juya Halin Copernicus," wanda ya samo asali daga sabon hangen nesa na Sararin Duniya da Copernicus ya gabatar

question: Wanne daga cikin waɗannan ayyukan ne zai baiwa ɗalibai damar yin nazari mai zurfi a kan Ka'idar kiyaye kuzarin inji?
answer_a: A yi amfani da jirgi mai gangara, a lura da motsin kwallo tana mirginawa a kansa
answer_b: Da taimakon na'urar auna mai dacewa, rubuta saurin da wata ƙwallo za ta kai ƙasa yayin da aka sako ta daga kan teburi.
answer_c: Amfani da rili mai siffar U, wanda a kansa ƙwallo ke birgima, ka kula da tsayi mafi girma da take kai wa a tsawon lokaci
answer_d: Daga wani kwaikwayon kwamfuta na abin hawa mai santsi mara jijiya (frictionless roller coaster), ka tantance kuzarin motsi (kinetic) da kuzarin wuri (potential) na keken da ke motsi a kansa

question: Bayan da malama ta yi nazari tare da ɗalibanta na aji na biyu na sakandare kan manufar ma'aunin ƙarfi mai miƙewa, malamar ta gabatar da wannan aikin koyarwa-koyi mai zuwa: Ɗalibai su raba kansu zuwa ƙananan ƙungiyoyi kuma su auna ma'aunin ƙarfi mai miƙewa na bazara ta hanyar gwaji, suna rubuta sakamakon su a cikin teburi. Haka kuma, za su tantance iyakar ƙarfin da bazara ke bin dokar Hooke. A ƙarshe, za su shirya rahoto a cikin nau'in fasta, wanda daga baya za su gabatar wa abokan karatun su. Waɗanne daga cikin waɗannan ƙwarewar bincike na kimiyya za a iya bunƙasa su kai tsaye ta hanyar wannan aikin?
answer_a: Auna binciken kimiyya domin inganta shi, tare da la'akari da inganci da amincin sakamakon
answer_b: Ku tsara tambayoyi da/ko matsaloli, bisa tushen ilimin kimiyya, waɗanda za a iya warware su ta hanyar binciken kimiyya
answer_c: Bayyana tare da bayar da hujjoji daga binciken kimiyya, a rubuce da kuma a baki, gami da tebura, zane-zane, misalai, da fasahar sadarwa ta zamani (ICT)
answer_d: Tsara tsare-tsaren binciken gwaji iri-iri waɗanda za su amsa wata tambaya kuma/ko wata matsala bisa ga majiyoyin bayanan kimiyya daban-daban, la'akari da amfani da ya dace na kayan aiki da abubuwa don tabbatar da tattara bayanai ingantattu.

question: Don sashin "Ƙarfin Lantarki da Cajojin Lantarki" a Aji na Goma Sha Biyu, wata malama tana so ɗalibanta su fahimci yadda ake kafa dokoki ta hanyar nazarin dangantaka tsakanin masu canji na zahiri. A cikin mahallin dokar Ohm, wace aiki ce daga cikin waɗannan ayyuka ta dace da wannan manufa?
answer_a: Ɗalibai suna zana jadawalin ƙarfin wutar lantarki a kan ƙarfin lantarki don wani zangon lantarki mai kyau, suna la'akari da cewa juriya abu ce mai tsayayyiya.
answer_b: Dalibai suna ƙirƙirar ginshiƙi daga tebur da ke rubuta tsananin wutar lantarki a cikin mai gudanarwa ga folti daban-daban, sa'annan su fassara shi
answer_c: Dalibai suna ƙididdige ƙarfin hana wucewa na na'urori daban-daban; a kowane yanayi an ba su ƙimar ƙarfin wutar lantarki da ƙarfin wuta mai gudana waɗanda aka auna ta hanyar gwaji
answer_d: Dalibai suna karɓar rezistoci daban-daban kuma suna tabbatarwa, ta hanyar sanya ƙarfin wuta da aka ƙayyade a kan kowannensu, ko juriyar da masana'anta suka ruwaito daidai ce

question: A matsayin wani ɓangare na aiki a cikin sashen Zafi da Yanayin Zafi, wata malama ta ba wa ɗaliban Makarantar Sakandare na Shekara ta Biyu karatu mai zuwa: A ƙarni na 17, ayyukan hakar ma'adanai da yawa sun kai zurfin da fitar da ruwan da ya taru a ƙasa ya zama babbar matsala, kuma dole ne dawakai ko mutane su yi amfani da famfunan da ke fitar da ruwan. A wannan lokacin, masana kimiyya irin su Torricelli ko von Guericke sun yi gagarumin ci gaba dangane da matsin lamba na sararin samaniya, wanzuwar sararin fanko, da abin da ake kira ƙarfin motsi na wuta. Na farko da ya yi yunƙurin gina na'ura don ɗaga ruwa bisa ga waɗannan ci gaba shi ne Papin, kodayake ba a taɓa gina tsarinsa ba. Savery ya fi samun nasara, wanda ya haɓaka na'ura inda aka ƙirƙiro sararin fanko yayin da tururin ruwan ya yi sanyi. A cikin 1712, Newcomen ya gina na'ura mai amfani, wanda, saboda baya buƙatar matsin lamba na tururi mai yawa, ya fi aminci sosai, kuma an yi amfani da shi har tsawon shekara saba'in ba tare da buƙatar manyan gyare-gyare ba. Mataki na gaba Watt ne ya ɗauka, wanda, da yake ya san abubuwan da Black ya gano game da zafi mai ɓoye, ya sami ra'ayin raba kayan sanyaya daga jikin na'urar, inda ya gina na'ura ta farko da wannan tsari a cikin 1776. Na'urar Watt, wadda ta fi arha kuma ta fi inganci, an kuma fara amfani da ita a masana'antar ƙarfe da masana'antar saka. An fitar da wannan na'ura daga Ingila zuwa ƙasashe masu son zama masu masana’antu, kamar su Faransa, Jamus, da Rasha. Wannan fasaha ita ce farkon juyin juya hali wanda ya ci gaba har zuwa yau kuma ya ba da damar haɓaka sabbin aikace-aikacen fasaha na zamani. Waɗanne ayyuka ne daga cikin waɗannan ɗalibai za su iya yi daga karatun rubutun da ya gabata?
answer_a: Bayyana aikin injin tururi da Watt ya ƙirƙira
answer_b: Yi nazari mai zurfi a kan tsare-tsaren kimiyya, neman amfaninsu da iyakokinsu wajen bayyana al'amuran halitta
answer_c: Samar da misalai, wakilci, ko kwatance waɗanda za su ba su damar danganta abubuwan Fiziya da fahimtar al'amuran duniya na yau da kullum
answer_d: Bayanin yadda ake la'akari da tsari mai ƙarfi da juyin halitta na gina ilimi, wanda kuma ci gabansa yana da alaƙa da yanayin zamantakewa da tarihi

question: A cikin koyarwar Fizik, an gane cewa akwai ra'ayoyi na farko marasa inganci waɗanda suke ruwan dare, waɗanda ɗalibai suke da su kuma suke shafar koyon sababbin tunani da ra'ayoyin kimiyya da suka danganci batun 'Zafi da Ma'aunin Zafi.' Wanne daga cikin zaɓuɓɓukan da ke gaba BA YA dace da ɗaya daga cikin waɗannan ra'ayoyi na farko marasa inganci ba?
answer_a: Zafi yana ƙunshe a cikin tsare-tsare
answer_b: Sanyi shine kishiyar zafi ko rashinsa
answer_c: Zafi yana nufin kasancewar tsare-tsare guda biyu ko fiye.
answer_d: Zafi yana da zafin jiki a matsayin ma'aunin ma'auni na zahirinsa

question: A cikin mahallin darasin "Sauti" a makarantar sakandare, ana sa ran ɗalibai za su iya bayyana dalilin da ya sa akwai bambance-bambance a yanayin sauti (timbre) tsakanin sauti ɗaya da aka samar da kayan kiɗa daban-daban. Waɗanne ra'ayoyi ne suke dole ga ɗalibai don su bayar da bayani mai gamsarwa game da ra'ayin yanayin sauti?
answer_a: Ƙarfi da sautin murya
answer_b: Haɗe-haɗen raƙuman ruwa da 'harmonics'
answer_c: Rabuwa da koma na igiyar sauti
answer_d:
system
Mita da tsawon zango na igiyar sauti

question: Malami na so ya tantance nasarar da ɗalibansa suka samu kan manufar koyo mai zuwa: “Tsara bayanai game da wasu al’amuran lantarki (electrostatic phenomena), kamar su karkarar jikuna (electrization of bodies) da fitar lantarki (electric discharges).” Wanne ne daga cikin waɗannan alamomin tantancewa ya dace don tantance wannan manufa?
answer_a: Sun bayyana sharuɗɗan gudanar da wutar lantarki a cikin daskararru, ruwa, da gas, tare da kawo misalai ga kowanne yanayi
answer_b: Suna bayyana sauye-sauye da sharuɗɗan da ke ƙayyade girman ƙarfin lantarki tsakanin caji biyu, ta amfani da dokar Coulomb.
answer_c: Suna bayyana hanyoyin aiki da fasahohi da ke kare mutane daga wasu abubuwan lantarki masu haɗari, kamar su kafa ƙasa (grounding) da sandunan tsawa (lightning rods), da sauransu
answer_d: Suna bayyana cewa na'urorin da ke gudanar da wutar lantarki suna da juriya ta lantarki, kuma tana dogara ne da juriyarsu ta zahiri, tsawonsu, fadin yankin da suka rufe, da kuma zafin jiki

question: Malam yana neman tsara aikin tantancewa ga ɗalibansa na aji goma (sophomores) a babbar makaranta wanda zai ba da damar tabbatar da ko sun haɓaka ƙwarewar tunani na kimiyya: 'Gano iyakokin samfura (models) da ka'idodin kimiyya.' A cikin mahallin babin 'Ƙarfi da motsi: motsi da dokokinsa', wane ne daga cikin ayyukan da ɗaliban suka yi zai ba malamin damar tantance ci gaban ƙwarewar da aka ambata?
answer_a: Ka tsara kuma ka aiwatar da wata hanya don auna saurin juyawa na wani jiki da ke zamiya ƙasa a kan wani farfajiya mai gangara, inda za a kwatanta ma'aunansa don kusurwoyi daban-daban
answer_b: Sanyaya gwaji don sanin saurin da wani abu ke motsi a ciki faduwa mara tarewa kuma a kwatanta sosai bayanan da aka samu da hasashen ka'ida
answer_c: Warware matsalolin motsi a mike mai hanzari, ta hanyar amfani da ra'ayoyin kinematics da kuma dangantakar lissafi dake tsakaninsu, domin daga nan sai su kwatanta sakamakon su da tunanin su na baya
answer_d: Yi lissafin lokutan faɗuwa, matsakaicin tsayin da aka kai, da gudun dukan ƙasa, ta hanyar amfani da tsarin da ke bayyana faɗuwar 'yanci da harbi a tsaye, tare da kwatanta sakamakon da abokan aikin su

question: Malamar kimiyyar lissafi, don kammala darasin "Haske", ta gabatar da wannan aikin tantancewa mai biyo baya ga ɗalibanta na ajin farko na sakandare: Ga yanayi guda biyu a ƙasa inda fitilu masu girma dabam-dabam ke haskaka allo. a) Kwatanta nau'in inuwar da za ta bayyana a kan allo a yanayi na 1 da na 2. b) Ka ba da hujja ga amsarka ta amfani da tsarin ɓararraƙi na haske da kuma geometriyar haske. Wace ƙwarewar kimiyya ce za a iya tantancewa ta hanyar wannan aikin?
answer_a: Bayyana bayanai ta hanyar samfuran kimiyya
answer_b: Fassara bayanai daga binciken kimiyya
answer_c: Ƙirƙiro bayanai a kan dogara ga ilimin kimiyya da ƙa'idoji
answer_d: Gane iyakokin da tsarin kimiyya da ka'idoji suke gabatarwa

question: Malam ko malama na aiki tare da ɗalibansu na shekara ta 3 a babbar sakandare a kan manufar ƙayyadadden zafi (specific heat), a cikin mahallin babin Zafi da zafin jiki (Heat and temperature). Wanne daga cikin misalan yau da kullum da ke gaba ya dace don gabatar da wannan manufa?
answer_a: Idan aka fitar da gwangwani na abin sha da ya daɗe a cikin firij, digo-digo na ruwa suna samuwa a jikin sa
answer_b: Ko da wutar da aka doro ta da ƙarfi take, zafin tukunya mai ruwan zãfi ba zai ƙaru ba matuƙar akwai ruwa a cikin tukunyar
answer_c: Bayan an raba miyar na wani lokaci, dankalin har yanzu yana da zafi sosai don a ci, yayin da naman za a iya ci ba tare da matsala ba
answer_d: Idan aka bar kwalbar da aka fentin ta da baƙi da wata irin ta da aka fentin ta da fari a rana, dukansu suna da ruwa a ciki, kwalbar baƙi tana kai zafi mafi girma fiye da farar

question: Dangane da koyar da Kimiyyar Polymers a Makarantar Tsakiya, wanne daga cikin zaɓuɓɓukan nan zai zama jerin da ya fara daga fadi zuwa ga mai takaituwa?
answer_a: Da farko, ka nuna misalan monomers, sa'annan ka yi bayanin yadda ake samuwar polymers ta hanyar amfani da sunadarai masu dacewa, daga ƙarshe kuma ka kawo misalan polymers na halitta da waɗanda aka ƙirƙira da ake amfani da su a rayuwar yau da kullum.
answer_b: Fara da misalan polymer da ake amfani da su a rayuwar yau da kullum (na halitta da na wucin gadi), sannan ka bayyana yadda polymer ke samuwa ta hanyar halayen kemikal da suka dace, kuma a ƙarshe ka bayyana menene monomer
answer_c: Bayar da misalai na halitta da na wucin gadi na polima da ake amfani da su a kullum sannan a gano abubuwan da suke samar da su; sannan a bayyana yadda wadannan polima ke samuwa ta hanyar amfani da dukkanin sinadarai da ke tattare da su
answer_d: Bayyana halayen kemikal da ke samar da polima-poliman amfanin yau da kullum da kuma monoma-monomansu, sannan a bukaci cewa, ta hanyar kwatancin misalan, su gano wasu polima-poliman amfanin yau da kullum kuma su tsara halayen kemikal dinsu.

question: Wace ilimi ta baya ce ake bukata ɗalibai su haɓaka don fahimtar manufar jerin abubuwan rediyoaktif?
answer_a: Tsarin kwayar zarra (nucleus)
answer_b: Tsarin zarra na abu
answer_c: Tsarin kwayar halittar lantarki na atam (atoms)
answer_d: Tsarin sinadarin wani abu (ko) Karkatar sinadarin wani abu (ko) Tsarin isotoɓ ɗin wani abu

question: Lokacin darasi game da aikin rediyo, ɗalibai suna gudanar da bincike don bayyana kasancewar ƙarfe a cikin taurari mafi tsufa. Wacece daga cikin waɗannan abubuwan da ɗalibai suka koya a baya suke buƙata don gudanar da aikin?
answer_a: dangantakar daidaiton nau'i da kuzari
answer_b: Juyewar zarra
answer_c: Haɗewar nukiliya
answer_d: Rabuwar zarra

question: Wane ilimi na gaba ya zama dole ga ɗalibai don suyi aiki a kan ka'idar VSEPR a cikin kwayoyin halitta daban-daban?
answer_a: Lokacin juzu'i na ƙanƙanta wanda ke haifar da bambancin kwayoyin halitta
answer_b: Dokar duet da octet don samuwar kwayoyin halitta (molecules)
answer_c: Wakilcin sarƙoƙin sinadarai da ke cikin ƙwayoyin halitta
answer_d: Tsarin turjewar ma'auran electron na harsashi na karshe da aka yi amfani da shi ga kwayoyin halitta daban-daban

question: Wani malami ya gindaya manufar koyo mai zuwa ga ajinsa: Bayyana halayen pH yayin da ake tsakaita acid mai ƙarfi da base mai rauni. Wace ce daga cikin zaɓuɓɓukan nan alama ce mai dacewa da za a yi amfani da ita don wannan koyon?
answer_a: Suna zana lanƙwasan titiracin acid mai ƙarfi da tushe mai rauni
answer_b: Suna gudanar da ma'aunin sinadarai (titration) don kawar da karfin acid mai ƙarfi da sinadari mai rauni
answer_c: Suna auna yadda aka kakkabe ƙarfin wani acid mai ƙarfi da wani tushe (base) mai rauni bisa ga pKb na tushen
answer_d: Suna auna ma'aunin ƙarfin acid ɗin ne ta hanyar sanannen ma'aunin raunin base

question: A cikin ajin Chemistry, malamin ya gindaya cewa ɗalibai su bayyana kuma su nuna samuwar haɗin gwiwar ionic da covalent. Wace aikin kammalawa ce za ta ba malamin damar tabbatar da cimma manufarsa?
answer_a: Ya nuna musu Tsarin Lewis na wata molecule wadda ke ɗauke da nau'ukan haɗi guda biyu, kuma ya tambaye su su kirga electrons na valence
answer_b: Ya ba da jerin sinadarai kuma ya tambaye su su tantance ko za su cika dokar biyu (duet) ko dokar takwas (octet).
answer_c: Yana ba su alamomi da lambobin atom na abubuwa uku kuma ya ce su kafa kwayoyin halitta biyu, kowanne da a kalla ɗaya daga cikin nau'ikan haɗin gwiwa guda biyu
answer_d: Ya gabatar musu da wani teburi da ke nuna ma’aunin tafasawa da narkarwa na abubuwan sinadarai uku, kuma ya tambaye su su tantance nau’in ɗauri da za su yi

question: Wata malama tana aiki da ɗalibanta na shekara ta biyu a Makarantar Tsakiya. A matsayin wani ɓangare na shirinta, ta yi la'akari da kimanta nasarar mai nunin "Aiwatar da ra'ayin ƙarfin magani." Wane ne daga cikin waɗannan ayyukan ya shafi mai nunin kai tsaye?
answer_a: Suna narkar da abubuwa masu narkewa daban-daban a cikin ruwa kuma su bayyana irin maganin narkewa da ke samuwa gwargwadon yanayin zahiri na abin da aka narkar da abin da ya narkar
answer_b: Suna narkar da adadin abin narkewa daban-daban a cikin ƙayyadadden adadin ruwa, sannan su jeranta kowane cakuɗi a cikin tsarin haɓaka na rabon abin narkewa da mai narkarwa.
answer_c: Suna narkar da adadi daban-daban na narkararriyar abu (solute) a cikin kafaffen adadi na ruwa (fixed volume of water) a yanayi daban-daban na zafi, sannan su bayyana halayen narkararriyar abun.
answer_d: Suna narkar da kwayoyin narkewa daban-daban a cikin ruwan narkarwa iri-iri kuma suna bayyana halayen kowace kwayar narkewa gwargwadon ruwan narkarwan da aka nazarce.

question: Loko da ake darasi kan manyan aikace-aikacen batir ɗin lantarki (electrochemical cells) a masana'antu, farfesan ya ambaci wani batir ɗin lantarki na kasuwa mai suna Downs cell, wanda ke bada damar samun sinadarin sodium (metallic sodium) ta hanyar aikin rabawar lantarki (electrolysis) na narkararren gishirin sodium chloride (NaCl). Wanne daga cikin abubuwan da ke faruwa a ƙasa za'a iya gani yayin aikin batir ɗin Downs cell?
answer_a: Sodium ɗin ƙarfe yana taruwa a kan anode ta hanyar rage sinadarin sodium ions
answer_b: Iskar chlorine tana fitowa a cathode ta dalilin oxidation na chloride ions
answer_c: Ions na chloride suna motsawa zuwa anode domin oxidation
answer_d: Kwayoyin Sodium na matsawa zuwa ga cathode don rage su

question: Dangane da nazarin kwayoyin halitta masu ayyuka daban-daban, wata malama tana tattauna masu zaƙi na halitta da kuma na roba. Don yin haka, ta samar da muhawara mai zurfi a tsakanin ɗaliban game da alaƙar da ke tsakanin wasu masu zaƙi da ciwon daji. Wace ce daga cikin waɗannan hujjoji za a iya ɗauka a matsayin hujja ingantacciya ta kimiyya dangane da alaƙar masu zaƙi da lafiyar ɗan Adam?
answer_a: Saccharin yana haddasa ciwon daji na mafitsara, saboda akwai bincike-bincike a kan beraye waɗanda suke tabbatar da wannan
answer_b: Mai zaƙi na roba yana ƙunshe da ɗigon zarra masu haɗari ga lafiyar ɗan adam, kamar su chlorine, wanda zai iya haifar da cutar kansa
answer_c: Nazarin Ƙididdigar NCI ya nuna cewa yawan aukuwar ciwon daji na kwakwalwa gaba ɗaya ya fara ƙaruwa a shekarar 1973, shekaru takwas bayan an fara kasuwancin Aspartame
answer_d: Kungiyoyin kariya na lafiya a Amurka sun yi iƙirarin cewa yin amfani da kayan zaƙi ya jawo ciwon daji na mahaifa ga wasu matan Amurka

question: Rukunin ɗalibai na buƙatar su gano ta hanyar gwaji wanzuwar rukunin aiki a cikin mahadi na halitta. Don yin hakan, suna amfani da mahadi na Carbonyl, kamar formaldehyde da acetone, kuma don gane su, Tollens' reagent da chromic acid, suna yin wannan tsari na aiki: 1. Suna saka 2 mL na formaldehyde a bututun gwaji ɗaya da kuma 2 mL na acetone a wani bututun. 2. Suna ƙara 2 mL na Tollens' reagent ga kowane bututun gwaji. 3. Suna dumama bututun/bututai a wankan ruwa inda ba a ga wata canji ba. 4. Suna maimaita mataki na 1 kuma su ƙara 2 mL na chromic acid ga kowane bututun gwaji. Bisa ga sakamakon da ake tsammani a cikin gwajin, wane irin kammalawa ne ɗaliban ya kamata su cimma?
answer_a: Aikin sinadarin chromic ne kawai a gane ketones
answer_b: Sinadarin Tollens yana gane aldahidai kawai
answer_c: Akwai ikon da asid ɗin chromic ke bayarwa na gane kowace mahaɗar carbonyl
answer_d: Sinadarin Tollens na ba da damar gane kowane mahadi mai Karbonyl

question: Karanta halin da ke biyo baya: A cikin aji na farko na firamare, malami zai fara aiki a kan manufar lura da kuma bayyana canje-canjen da ke faruwa a cikin kayayyaki lokacin da aka yi amfani da karfi, haske, zafi, da ruwa. Wane jigo ne ya kamata malamin ya yi aiki a kai kafin ya tunkari wannan manufar?
answer_a: Canje-canje na yanayi a abubuwa daban-daban
answer_b: Sifofin ƙarfi, haske, zafi, da ruwa
answer_c: Nau'o'in abubuwa daban-daban da ake samu a rayuwar yau da kullum
answer_d: Aikin karfi, haske, zafi, ko ruwa a kan kayayyaki daban-daban

question: Malama tana koyar da tsarin Duniya tare da ɗalibanta na aji huɗu, kuma tana son ta bada misali kan sassan Duniya ta hanyar wani abu na yau da kullum. Wanne ne a cikin waɗannan abubuwan zai bada damar gabatar da batun da aka ambata a sarari?
answer_a: Kwai tafasasshe
answer_b: Matryoshka
answer_c: 'Ya'yan itace mai rabe-rabe
answer_d: Kwallon kumfa

question:
Karanta halin da ke gaba:
Malamar reno tana lura da Mariana, wadda ke durƙushe a harabar gida riƙe da gilashin ƙara gani a hannunta. Tana ganin yarinyar tana ɗaga duwatsu tana duba ƙarƙashinsu, tana bincike ƙarƙashin tsire-tsire, kuma tana raba busassun ganye. Malamar ta kusance ta, ta tambaye ta me take yi, sai Mariana ta yi bayani cewa tana neman ƙwari masu naɗewa saboda tana son su yi mirginawa a hannunta. Malamar ta tambaye ta, “Me ya sa kike tunanin ƙwarin masu naɗewa suke ɗaukar wannan matsayin?”
Wace ƙwarewar kimiyya ce malamar ke nufi da ita ainihi lokacin da take yi wa Mariana wannan tambayar?
answer_a: Annawarta
answer_b: Kula
answer_c: Gwaji
answer_d: Tattara bayanai

question: Malamar tana son sanin ko ɗalibanta za su iya tsara wani aiki na gwaji bisa ga tambayar da aka ba su. Wanne daga cikin waɗannan ayyukan zai ba da damar auna manufar?
answer_a: Suna nazarin zane-zane kuma suna fitar da bayanai daga cikinsu
answer_b: Suna amfani da kuma nazarin samfura don tallafa wa bayanansu
answer_c: Suna bambanta tambayoyi na kimiyya da waɗanda ba na kimiyya ba
answer_d: Suna gano sauye-sauyen masu dogaro da masu zaman kansa a cikin nazarin

question: Wace ɗaya daga cikin ayyuka masu zuwa ce za ta ba malami damar sanin ra'ayoyin farko na ɗalibai game da yadda fashewar aman wuta ke faruwa?
answer_a: Domin ɗalibai su gane sassan dutsen aman wuta a cikin zane mai nuna yanke.
answer_b: Dalibai su nuna fashewar dutsen wuta a cikin wani samfuri ta amfani da ruwan tsami, baking soda, tulun gilashi, da sauran kayan aiki
answer_c: Dalibai su bayyana, ta amfani da taswirar duniya da ke nuna farfajiyar ƙasa masu motsi, dalilin da ya sa aka kira Zoben Wuta na Fasifik da wannan suna
answer_d: Dalibai su zana kibau na motsin abu a cikin dutsen wuta, a hoto da ke nuna tsarin ciki na Geosphere da dutsen wuta.

question: Wanne daga cikin waɗannan ayyukan ne zai ba wa ɗalibai damar bincikar babban dalilin ɗumamar yanayi?
answer_a: Baitaƙaita wata mujalla ta kimiyya game da illolin chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs)
answer_b: Bincika wata makala ta kimiyya da ke ɗauke da bayanai game da yawan sinadarin CO2 a cikin yanayi daban-daban na shekara a birane daban-daban
answer_c: Ka taƙaita sakamakonni da ƙarshe-ƙarshen aikin tebur na digiri (thesis) kan ƙaruwar tattarawar CO2 a sararin samaniya
answer_d: Yi nazarin nazarin kimiyya wanda ke ɗauke da bayani dangane da tasirin juyawar zafi (thermal inversion) a kan tattarawar iskar gas masu gurbata muhalli

question: Malami ya gabatar da wannan kanun labarai na jarida ga ɗalibansa na aji 6: 'Gurbatar muhalli a ƙasar Chile na haddasa mutuwar wuri da bai kai lokaci ba sama da dubu huɗu sakamakon cututtukan zuciya da na huhu.' Bisa ga wannan kanun labarai na jarida, malamin ya nemi ɗalibansa su shirya tare da gudanar da muhawara kan matakan kariya don warware wannan matsala. Wanne ne daga cikin waɗannan alamomin koyo ya yi daidai da aikin da malamin ya gabatar?
answer_a: Suna nazarin zane-zane masu alaƙa da mutuwar da ba a kai ba daga cututtukan zuciya da jijiyoyi a cikin shekaru goma da suka gabata
answer_b: Suna kwatanta matakan rage yawan gurɓacewar muhalli da aka yi amfani da su a wasu ɓangarorin duniya
answer_c: Suna jayayya kan amfanoni da illolin mafita masu yiwuwa da za a iya aiwatarwa don rage gurbacewar muhalli
answer_d: Suna binciken dalilan da ya sa yawan gurɓata ke ƙaruwa a lokacin sanyi, da kuma matakan da aka ɗauka don rage wannan adadin

question: Malami ya yanke shawarar tantance ko ɗalibansa suna amfani da ilimin abinci mai gina jiki da suka koya a rayuwarsu ta zahiri. Waɗanne ayyuka ne suka dace da wannan manufa?
answer_a: A rukuni-rukuni, suna ƙirƙirar tsarin abinci daidaitacce ga matasa
answer_b: Dabam-dabam, sukan kirkiro abincin da ya dogara ga nauyinsu, tsayinsu, motsa jiki, da jinsinsu
answer_c: Kowannensu yana yin jeri na abinci mafi gina jiki da yake ci
answer_d: A rukuni, sukan yi nazari kan sakamakon wani bincike da aka gudanar a makarantarsu dangane da dabi'un cin abinci.

question: Malami ya tsara manufar koyo mai zuwa don ajin sa: Bayyana dangantakar dake tsakanin aikin kwayar halitta da sassan ta. Wace daga cikin waɗannan takamaiman manufofin koyo da aka gabatar don wani aiki zai yi daidai da manufar wannan aji?
answer_a: Ku siffanta tantanin halitta a matsayin ginshiƙin tsarin rayayyun halittu na asali
answer_b: Kwatanta gabobin halitta da tsarin salula da ke bayyane a nau'o'in salula daban-daban
answer_c: Siffanta halayen tsare-tsaren da ke wanzu a cikin ƙwayar halitta ta prokaryotic da ƙwayar halitta ta eukaryotic
answer_d: Danganta sassa daban-daban na kwayar halitta da gudunmawar masana kimiyya kamar su Hooke, Leeuwenhoek, Virchow, Schleiden, da Schwann

question: Malamar makaranta ta nemi dalibanta su yi aikin rukuni kamar haka: 1. Dole su zaɓi masu ba da kai guda uku: na farko zai sha ruwa mL 700, na biyu zai sha abin sha mai daidaita jiki (isotonic) mL 700, kuma na uku ba zai sha komai ba. 2. A cikin tsawon minti 90, dole su je bandaki su tattara fitsarinsu a minti na 30, minti na 60, da minti na 90. 3. A kowane ɗan gajeren lokaci, dole su auna adadin fitsarin da silinda mai ma'auni; da kuma nauyinsa (density), ta amfani da takardar gwajin fitsari. 4. A ƙarshe, dole su yi nazari kan abubuwan da ke cikin jini da/ko fitsari bisa ga sakamakon kowane ɗan mutum. Waɗanne ƙwarewar kimiyya da abubuwan fanni daliban za su yi aiki a kai da wannan aikin?
answer_a: Binciken bayanai, don nazarin ma'aunin ruwa
answer_b: Rikodin bayanai, don auna daidaita ƙarar jini
answer_c: Shirya dabarun bincike, don nazarin ma'aunin ruwa da gishiri
answer_d: Sarrafa masu canji, don fallasa tasirin ruwaye daban-daban a kan ma'aunin electrolytes a cikin fitsari

question: Wanne a cikin zaɓuɓɓuka masu zuwa ya nuna wata kuskure gama-gari game da canje-canje a cikin abu wanda ɗalibai a aji na 7/8 galibi suke da shi?
answer_a: Canje-canje na kemikal na iya zama masu juyawa ko marasa juyawa
answer_b: Tafasar ruwa na dacewa da canji wanda ba ya dawowa yadda yake
answer_c: Zafin yana ci gaba da kasancewa iri ɗaya idan ruwa ya canja daga mai tauri zuwa ruwa ruwa
answer_d:
system
Yawan wani abu yana kasancewa daidai lokacin da ya shiga sauyin sinadarai

question: Wata malama ta gabatar da wannan yanayi ga ɗalibanta: A ce muna da ruwa mai zafi a digiri 60°C a cikin gilashi ɗaya, kuma a wani gilashin kuma muna da ruwa daidai gwargwado a digiri 20°C. Mun zuba abin da ke cikin gilashin biyu a cikin gilashi na uku. Mene ne zafin hadin zai kasance? Sannan, ta umarce su da su yi hasashe dangane da tambayar, bisa lissafi, sannan su gudanar da gwajin a aikace. Bayan sun kammala, ɗaliban sun lura cewa zafin hadin ya yi ƙasa da wanda aka samu ta hanyar lissafin ka'ida. Na gaba, malamar ta nemi su ba da hujjoji kan dalilin da ya sa suke tunanin hakan ya faru kuma su nuna hasashen da suka yi lokacin da suke yin lissafin. Wace ce daga cikin waɗannan ayyuka (na ɗaliban) malamar ke ba da fifiko a cikin jerin koyon da ɗaliban suka gudanar?
answer_a: Gano kurakuran lissafi da aka yi a cikin irin wannan atisayen
answer_b: Bincika iyakokin samfurin da aka yi amfani da shi don yin lissafinsu
answer_c: Gano kura-kuran hanyar aiki da aka yi yayin aikin gwaji
answer_d: Gina wata hanya ta gwaji wacce zata bada damar samun bayanai masu dacewa da ka'idar sosai

question: Yayin da malami yake aiki da ɗalibai kan batun da'irorin lantarki, ya lura cewa ɗaya daga cikin ɗaliban yana tunanin cewa lokacin da aka haɗa fitilu masu kamanni da juna a jere, na farko zai haskaka fiye da na ƙarshe saboda igiyar lantarki tana ‘ƙarewa’ yayin da take ratsa kowace fitila a jere. Wanne daga cikin waɗannan ayyukan malami na gaba ne zai kalubalanci waɗannan tunani na ɗalibin kai tsaye?
answer_a: Nemi ɗalibin ya bayyana da nasa kalmomin abin da ke faruwa ga ƙarfin lantarki da banbancin volta a cikin sarƙar lantarki ta jere
answer_b: Gudanar da gwajin nunawa ta yadda ɗalibi zai iya lura da ƙarfin hasken fitilu idan aka haɗa su a jere
answer_c: Ka tambayi ɗalibin ya auna kuma ya kwatanta ƙarfin zangon wutar kowace fitila da aka haɗa a jere sannan ya bayyana abubuwan da ya lura da su
answer_d: Nuna kewayewa da fitilu huɗu haɗaɗɗu a layi ɗaya da wata da fitilu huɗu haɗaɗɗu a jere, kuma ka kwatanta abin da aka lura da shi.

question: Wata matsala aka gabatar wa wani ɗalibi kamar haka: DDT maganin kashe kwari ne da aka yi amfani da shi sosai; duk da haka, bayan wasu shekaru na amfani da shi sosai, ya rasa tasirinsa a kan kwari. Me ya sa DDT ya daina yin tasiri a kan kwari bayan amfani da shi sosai? Sai ɗalibin ya amsa kamar haka: Bayan wani lokaci mai tsawo na fuskantar DDT, kwarin sun samar da kariya wadda ta ba su damar su da zuriyarsu su zama marasa kamuwa da wannan maganin kwari. Wane ra'ayi na kuskure ne ya bayyana a amsar ɗalibin?
answer_a: Daidaikun halittu a cikin yawan halittu waɗanda ke da tsare-tsare ko hanyoyin aiki masu fa'ida za su rayu kuma su bar zuriya
answer_b: Halittun da ke cikin wata al'umma waɗanda suka samu sauye-sauye masu fa'ida za su rayu kuma za su isar da wannan sauyin ga 'ya'yansu.
answer_c: Daidaikun a cikin al'umma, domin su dace da yanayi, dole ne su samar da sifofi ko matakai waɗanda za su ba su damar rayuwa da barin zuriya
answer_d: Galibin mutane a cikin jama'a suna mutuwa yayin da suke fafatawa da waɗanda ke gabatar da bambance-bambance masu amfani, tare da na ƙarshe kasancewa waɗanda za su bar zuriya

question: Don bunkasa sashin Hanyoyin kiyaye bayanan kwayoyin halitta, malama ta sanya maƙasudin koyo mai zuwa: "Fahimtar cewa akwai hanyoyin da ke ba da damar kiyaye bayanan kwayoyin halitta." Don cimma wannan, ta zaɓi abubuwan ciki kamar haka: 1. Hayewa (Crossing-over). 2. Juyawar kwayoyin halitta (Chromosomal permutation). 3. Lokacin hutun kwayar halitta (Interphase) da rarrabuwar kwayar halitta a cikin kwayoyin halittun jiki da na jima'i (somatic and sexual cells). 4. Tsarin abubuwan kwayoyin halitta a cikin kwayar halitta (Organization of genetic material in the cell). 5. Ma'ajizan sarrafa rarrabuwar kwayar halitta (Cell division control points). Wace ce daga cikin jerin tsarin koyo da za ta ba malamar damar tsara abubuwan ciki daga gaba ɗaya zuwa takamaiman bayani?
answer_b: huɗu - uku - biyar - ɗaya - biyu

question: A wani ajin gabatarwa na darasin 'Kwayar Halitta', wani malami yana so ya yi amfani da wata dabara da za ta ba ɗalibansa damar su fahimci cewa kimiyya tsari ne mai motsi na gina ilimi, wanda ci gabansa ke da tasiri a kan al'umma. Wace ce daga cikin dabarun da ke gaba za ta ba malamin damar cimma manufar da aka sa a gaba?
answer_a: Ka umarci ɗalibai su kirkiro samfuri game da fitar da sunadarin gina jiki a cikin kwayar halitta, kuma su nuna wane masanin kimiyya ne ya fara bayyana wannan hanyar.
answer_b: Ku nuna wa ɗalibai hotuna daban-daban na ƙwayoyin halitta da aka samu ta amfani da nau'ikan na'urorin hangen nesa daban-daban
answer_c: Ku nemi ɗalibai su rubuta muƙala a kan gudummawar masana kimiyya daban-daban ga ka'idar ƙwayar halitta
answer_d: Tsara wani aikin aikace-aikace domin ɗalibai su iya hango nau'o'in ƙwayoyin halitta daban-daban kuma su danganta tsarinsu da ayyukansu

question: A cikin aiwatar da wani yanki na koyarwa game da yanayin wutar lantarki na abubuwa, wani malami ya tsara jerin ayyuka kamar haka: 1. Ya gabatar wa ɗalibai su gudanar da jerin gwaje-gwaje don gano asalin wutar lantarki. 2. Malamin ya tambayi ɗalibai game da asalin wutar lantarki kuma ya rubuta amsoshin da aka tattara a kan allo a cikin zaman tattaunawar zubi-cikin-zubi. 3. An shirya ɗalibai zuwa ƙungiyoyi da aka bayyana matsayinsu kuma aka ba su: balan-balan, takardu, zaren, da kuma mizani. 4. Malamin ya umurci ɗalibai su shafa balan-balan ɗin da aka hura da kuma mizani da gashin kansu ko wani yanki na tufafi, sannan su kusantar da su zuwa ƙananan abubuwa, kamar guntun takarda da kuma gutsuren zaren da aka rataye. 5. An nemi ɗalibai su yi sharhi kuma su rubuta abin da suka gani. 6. A ƙarshe, an ba su lokaci don haɓaka bayanan da suka yarda da su tare game da asalin wutar lantarki. Wanne daga cikin zaɓuɓɓuka masu zuwa ya dace da iyakancewar aikin da aka gudanar?
answer_a: Ba a yi magana a kan abun ciki na halaye ba
answer_b: Abun ciki na ra'ayi da aka yi aiki a kansa ba a tsara shi ba
answer_c: Ba a bunƙasa dabarun tunani na kimiyya ba
answer_d: Kallace-kallace ba su da alaƙa da abubuwan da suka gabata

question: Malami ya haɗa da aikin da ke gaba a cikin jarabawar kimiyyar motsi: “Wani abu yana motsi bisa ga lissafin da ke gaba: x=25+40t−5t2 (inda t yake a cikin daƙiƙa kuma x a cikin mita). Wace nisa abin zai yi tafiya a daƙiƙa 5 da daƙiƙa 6?” Bayan nazarin amsoshin, malamin ya lura cewa ɗalibansa ba su gane cewa, bisa ga sakamakonsu, abin zai yi tafiya kaɗan a cikin tsawon lokaci ba, tunda yawancinsu sun amsa cewa abin ya yi tafiya mita 100 a cikin daƙiƙa 5 da mita 85 a cikin daƙiƙa 6. Wanne daga cikin zaɓuɓɓukan da ke gaba ya dace da wani abu wanda zai bayyana wahalar da yawancin ɗaliban suka fuskanta?
answer_a: Rikice-rikicen da ke tattare da karanta bayanan matsalolin kimiyyar motsi
answer_b: Rashin horo wajen gano bayanan da aka bayar da kuma amfani da dacewar lissafi (equations)
answer_c: Rashin wadatar tunani na inganci game da sakamakon lambobi da aka samu a matsalolin kinematics
answer_d: Rashin bunkasa fasahar lissafi don fuskantar warwarewar matsalolin kinematics

question: Don magance manufar koyo “Danganta bambancin zafi da canjin kuzarin zafi tsakanin abubuwa daban-daban,” wani malami ya sa ɗalibansa su yi ayyuka kamar haka, suna amfani da abubuwa guda biyu. 1. Ƙididdige zafin da wani abu ya karɓa. 2. Auna da kwatanta zafin abubuwan guda biyu. 3. Tantance inda zafi ke gudana tsakanin abubuwan guda biyu. 4. Ƙididdige ƙarfin zafi na abubuwan. Wanne daga cikin zaɓuɓɓukan nan ya gabatar da jerin ci gaba, wanda ya fara daga ra'ayoyin yau da kullum zuwa ga waɗanda suka fi ma'ana?
answer_a: Biyu - Huɗu - Ɗaya - Uku
answer_b: ɗaya - uku - huɗu - biyu
answer_c: Biyu - Uku - Ɗaya - Huɗu

question: Malami ya tambayi ɗalibai "menene ƙarfi?", kuma kusan dukansu sun yarda cewa shi ne "aiki da ake buƙata don kiyaye jiki cikin motsi". Wanne ne daga cikin waɗannan albarkatun ya fi dacewa don ƙalubalantar wannan kuskure tsakanin ɗaliban?
answer_a: Hoto na wata matashiya tana jan tebur
answer_b: Hoton ɗan wasan ƙwallon ƙafa yana harbin ƙwallo
answer_c: Hoto na yaro ɗauke da jakar baya a bayansa
answer_d: Hoton kibiya a cikin iska bayan an harba ta

question: Malamar tana da burin ƙarfafa wa ɗalibanta ikon zaɓar bayanai daga intanet don gina ayyukan bincike. A cikin aji, ta ce su yi amfani da na’urar bincike ta intanet don neman bayanai game da yiwuwar hasashen girgizar ƙasa. Wace daga cikin waɗannan ayyukan da malamar ta gabatar za ta ba ɗaliban damar cimma manufar da aka faɗa?
answer_a: Dubi gidaje uku na yanar gizo sannan ka zaɓi wanda ya fi dacewa da kai, kana nuna a sarari me kake dogara da shi a zaɓinka
answer_b: Rubuta makala bisa ga bayanin daga shafin yanar gizo wanda ya fi jan hankalinsu
answer_c: ƙirƙiri ginshiƙin kwatance na bayanan da aka buga a rukunonin yanar gizo uku na farko da suka ziyarta
answer_d: Jeranta shafukan yanar gizo uku na farko da suka ziyarta daga mafi inganci zuwa mafi ƙarancin inganci, tare da bayar da hujjar ma'aunin da aka yi amfani da shi

question: A cikin mahallin babin nan "Zarra da Ƙwayarta," wani malami ya gabatar da aiki mai zuwa ga dalibansa na aji huɗu na sakandare: "Ku yi muhawara a kan tasirin nazarin ƙwayar zarra da yiwuwar amfaninta na fasaha, idan aka yi la'akari da cewa, daga abin da ke faruwa a cikin ƙwayar zarra ta wasu abubuwa, yana yiwuwa a samu wutar lantarki da kuma haɓaka fasahohin da ke amfanar da jama'a. Musamman, ku tattauna yiwuwar gina tashoshin samar da wutar lantarki na nukiliya a ƙasarmu don samar da wutar lantarki." Wace manufar koyo za a iya cimma ta hanyar gudanar da wannan aikin da aka gabatar?
answer_a: Bayyana tsarin atom da kwayarsa, gane bambance-bambance tsakanin nau'o'i daban-daban da isoto-isotansu, da kuma manyan karfin da ke tattare da su
answer_b: Gina fahimta a cikin ɗalibai game da yanayin ilimin kimiyya na kwayar zarra da ayyukan masana kimiyyar kwayar zarra
answer_c: Haɓaka sha'awar ɗalibai wajen haɗa nazarin kwayar zarra (atomic nucleus) da amfani da ita a fannin fasaha da kuma al'amuran rayuwar yau da kullum
answer_d: Haɓaka basirar ɗalibai na bayyana yadda ake samun makamashi daga tsakiyar ƙwayar zarra da yadda za a iya canza wannan makamashin zuwa makamashin lantarki

question: Karanta wannan manufar koyo mai zuwa: "Bayyana abubuwan da haske ke aikatawa ta hanyar gwaji da amfani da samfura, tare da la'akari da samfuran barbashi da na raƙuman ruwa na haske." Wanne daga cikin waɗannan ma'aunan tantancewa ne zai tantance manufar da aka ambata kai tsaye?
answer_a: Bayanin darrabin haske (diffraction) ta amfani da yanayin taguwar haske
answer_b: Gano abubuwan da ke faruwa na haske masu alaƙa da tsarin ɓarɓara na haske
answer_c: Bayyana mahimmancin tasirin Doppler ta hanyar gano abubuwan da ake amfani da shi, bisa ga samfurin raƙuman ruwa
answer_d: Gano yanayi na yau da kullum inda ake iya lura da al'amuran haske daban-daban masu alaƙa da samfurin barbashi

question: Wata malama ta gabatar wa dalibanta wannan aiki mai zuwa: Ku gina wani samfuri don wakiltar tsarin Duniya da Wata a kan ma'auni kuma ku kwaikwayi kusufin rana ta amfani da hasken majigi maimakon hasken Rana. A lokacin aikin da aka ambata, wace daga cikin ayyukan da daliban suka yi ce za ta ba su damar kimanta fahimtar su game da tsarin da ke haifar da kusufin rana?
answer_a: Suna nuna cewa Duniya, Wata, da Rana sun yi layi, suna samar da inuwa a kan Duniya
answer_b: Suna bayyana cewa kusufin rana yana faruwa ne a lokacin da wata ya jefa inuwarsa a saman duniya
answer_c: Suna kwaikwayon motsin duniyar Wata a kewayen duniya a cikin tsawon wata ɗaya cikakke
answer_d: Suna gina samfuri inda nisan dake tsakanin Duniya da Wata da kuma girmansu an nuna su a sikelin ma'auni guda ɗaya.

question: Malami yana son ya auna iyawar ɗalibansa wajen tsara matsalar wani bincike na kimiyya wanda ke da nufin tantance abubuwan da shawagin wani jiki ya dogara a kansu. Wanne a cikin ayyuka masu zuwa da ɗaliban suka gudanar zai bai wa malamin damar auna wannan iyawar?
answer_a: Suna gudanar da gwaji don tabbatar da abubuwan da ke shafar shawagar jiki, suna ba da shawarar kayan aiki da kayan gwaji masu dacewa (ruwaye daban-daban, abubuwa na kayan daban, nauyi, da siffa)
answer_b: Suna shirya bayanan da aka samo daga auna ƙarfin nauyi (densities) da lura da ruwan jikin abubuwa daban-daban a cikin ruwaye daban-daban, suna nazari da kuma yanke hukunci a kan abin da ruwan jikin abubuwan ya dogara a kai
answer_c: Suna amfani da shaidun da suka samu daga lura da ruwan jikuna a cikin ruwa daban-daban da kuma daga ma'aunin nauyi (density), suna amfani da hankali da kuma gina gardama don bayanin da suka gabatar.
answer_d: Suna tsara wata hasashe mai gwadawa wadda ke danganta dumuwar jikin mutane da mabanbantan abubuwa, kamar siffa, yawa (density), da girma (volume), suna kafa dangantaka mai ma'ana tsakanin wadannan ra'ayoyi na kimiyya don jagorantar tsarin gwajinsu

question: Wani malami zai fara darasin haɗin gwiwar sinadarai (chemical bonding) kuma yana so ya nuna wa ɗalibai cewa ilimin sinadarai tsari ne mai ci gaba, mai kuzari, kuma cike da saɓanin ra'ayoyi. Don cimma haka, wane ne a cikin ayyuka masu zuwa zai dace?
answer_a: Mahawara game da samfuran atomic
answer_b: Nemi rahoton bincike a kan ka'idar VSEPR
answer_c: Muhawara game da nuna dokokin iskar gas
answer_d: Nemi bincike na rubuce-rubuce game da tarihin manufar haɗin gwiwa (bonding)

question: Wani malami a aji na biyu na Sakandare ya gabatarwa ɗalibansa ma'aunan rabewar cikin ruwa (aqueous dissociation) na gishirin sodium guda biyu: NaCl(s)+H2O(l)→Na+(aq)+Cl−(aq) NaHCO3(s)+H2O(aq)→Na+(aq)+HCO3−(aq). Lokacin da aka tambaye su game da ikon narkewar dukkan gishirin biyu, ɗaliban suka amsa cewa dukkan gishirin biyu suna da narkewa ɗaya a cikin ruwa. Bayan sun gudanar da gwaji, sun gane cewa ba su da narkewa ɗaya. Wanne daga cikin zaɓuɓɓuka masu zuwa ne ke wakiltar kuskuren fahimta daga ɗaliban game da narkewar waɗannan gishirin?
answer_a: Hakan ya danganta a kan adadin ions da ke rabuwa daga kowane gishiri
answer_b: Cewa yana dogara ne ga girman kwayoyin caji da suke rabuwa daga kowace gishiri
answer_c: Ya danganta ne da jikawar ruwan narkarwa ga yan gurbatattun abubuwa (ions)
answer_d: Ya dogara ne ga hulɗar kwayoyin halitta tsakanin abin narke da abin narkarwa

question: Wanne daga cikin waɗannan maganganun kuskure ne gama gari da ɗalibai ke yi game da yanayin kasancewar kai tsaye a cikin matakan ilimin kimiyyar zafin jiki (thermodynamic processes)?
answer_a: Ɗalibai sun yarda cewa ƙaruwar entropy tana tallafawa kai-tsaye
answer_b: Dalibai sun tabbatar cewa hanyoyi masu faruwa da kansu za su iya zama masu fitar da zafi
answer_c: Dalibai suna ganin cewa tafiyar matakai marasa buƙatar gaggawa suna da saurin motsi
answer_d: Dalibai na ɗauka cewa matakai masu faruwa ba zato ba tsammani sun dogara ne ga zafi da tarwatsewar kuzari

question: Malami yana so ajinsa ya gane Dokar Hund ta Matsakaicin Yawaita. Wanne daga cikin waɗannan ayyukan tantancewa ne zai fi tabbatar da cewa ɗalibai sun cimma wannan manufa?
answer_a: Don rubuta cikakkun tsare-tsare na lantarki na duniya na atom daban-daban a cikin yanayin ƙasa
answer_b: Rubuta taƙaitaccen tsarin lantarki na zarru daban-daban a yanayi na asali
answer_c: Don kwatanta rarrabar electrons a zanukan orbital na harsashin valence na wasu zarru daban-daban
answer_d: Don kwatanta tsare-tsaren na'urorin lantarki na waje na nau'o'in atom daban-daban a cikin yanayin ƙasa da na gaggawa

question: Malamar aji na farko na makarantar sakandare ta tsara aikin nan don ɗalibanta: Ɗauki kofuna biyar masu ɗauke da 50 mL na ruwa mai tsafta, kuma a narkar da waɗannan a cikinsu: 5 g na gishiri (NaCl), 5 g na sukar, 5 g na bicarbonate, 5 mL na mai, 5 mL na barasa. Sannan, malamar ta tambaye su su bayyana dalilin da yasa wasu daga cikin abubuwan da aka ƙara suke narkewa gaba ɗaya, wasu kuma wani ɓangare, wasu kuma ba su narkewa ko kaɗan. Wanne daga cikin manufofin da ke biyo baya ya dace da wannan aikin?
answer_a: Gwada da narkewar abubuwa masu polar da marasa polar a cikin narke-narke daban-daban
answer_b: Bayyana yadda halayen abubuwa daban-daban suke kasancewa idan aka narkar da su a cikin wani mai narke mara iyakantaccen juzu'i (non-polar solvent)
answer_c: Danganta mu'amalolin tsakanin kwayoyin halitta da narkewar kayan abubuwa daban-daban a cikin ruwa
answer_d: Rarraba tasirin juna na kwayoyin halitta bisa ga narkewarsu a cikin ruwa

question: A cikin darasi na haɗin sinadarai, malamin yana son dalibai su tantance nau'o'i daban-daban na mu'amala tsakanin kwayoyin halitta kuma su haɓaka ƙwarewar kimiyya. Wanne daga cikin ayyukan da ke gaba zai baiwa malamin damar tabbatar da cikar burin?
answer_a: Ku nemi ɗalibai su rarraba nau'in kwayoyin halitta daban-daban bisa ga mu'amalarsu ta cikin kwayar halitta guda ɗaya.
answer_b: Umurci ɗalibai su gina taswirar ra'ayi dangane da karatun sashin hulɗa tsakanin ƙwayoyi na littafin karatu
answer_c: Umurci dalibai su yi nazarin kasancewar mu'amala ta cikin kwayar halitta a cikin abubuwan halitta
answer_d: Tambayi ɗalibai su tsara wata hanyar gwaji don gano kasancewar nau'o'in mu'amalar tsakanin kwayoyi daban-daban

question: Ɗaya daga cikin manufofin koyo na tsarin koyarwa na Kimiyyar Rayuwa na Aji na Biyu yana nufin ɗalibai su fahimci cewa wasu dabbobi suna raba halaye na zahiri, wanda hakan ke ba da damar a rarraba su a cikin rukuni ɗaya. Wace daga cikin waɗannan ayyuka ce ke ƙarfafa ɗalibai su yi amfani da ikon rarraba dabbobi?
answer_a: Kwatanta halayen da za a iya gani na dabbobi daban-daban da aka gabatar a cikin hotuna daban-daban
answer_b: Rarraba hotunan dabbobi gwargwadon nau'in abin rufe jikinsu
answer_c: Zana dabbobi bisa ga siffofin da aka bayar
answer_d: Danganta dabbobi daban-daban da wurin da suke zaune

question: Malamar aji na uku ta kasance tana aiki tare da ɗalibanta kan manufar "Kula da bayyanawa, ta hanyar binciken gwaji, abubuwan da shuka ke buƙata." Don tantance wannan burin, ta gabatar da binciken gwaji mai zuwa: A cikin kofuna uku masu haske waɗanda ke da ramukan zubar ruwa, kuma waɗanda ke ɗauke da yawan ƙasa iri ɗaya kuma iri ɗaya ce ta gonar, sun shuka iri iri ɗaya a kowanne kofi. Sannan, sun ajiye kofunan a jikin taga na ajin kuma suna shayar da su da sirinji na ruwa mililita 10 tare da tsarin shayarwa mai zuwa: Shuka ta 1: sau ɗaya a rana. Shuka ta 2: sau ɗaya a mako. Shuka ta 3: sau biyu a mako. A ƙarshe, ta umarce su su rubuta abubuwan da suka lura da su da kuma abubuwan da suka kammala da su. Wace ɗabi'a ce daga cikin waɗannan ke nuna cewa ɗalibai sun sami damar samar da ƙarshen da ya dace daga gwajin da aka gudanar dangane da abin da ke canzawa?
answer_a: Suna danganta haske da ruwan da tsirrai ke bukata domin su rayu
answer_b: Suna gano sinadaran da ruwa ke bayarwa don girman tsirrai
answer_c: Suna tantance adadin ruwan da shuka ke buƙata don bunƙasarta
answer_d: Suna bayyana aikin saiwoyi wajen shanye ruwan da tsiron yake bukata

question: A makarantar gabanin firamare, malamar ta gaya wa yara maza da mata cewa za su yi gwaji, wanda ya shafi sanya ɗan kankara a wurin rana. Ta gaya musu cewa, cikin shiru, kowanne ya zana abin da yake tunanin zai faru da ɗan kankaran. Sai suka fita filin makaranta kuma ta ba kowannensu ɗan kankara don su ajiye shi a rana. Da suka koma ajin, sai ta nemi su zana a gefen zanen farko abin da suka gani da gaske ya faru da ɗan kankaran. A ƙarshe, ta nemi su bayyana yadda zanen guda biyu suke iri ɗaya da yadda suka bambanta, da kuma ko abin da suka yi tunani zai faru ya faru da gaske. Wace ƙwarewar kimiyya ce daga cikin waɗannan ke bayyana a ƙarshen wannan gwajin?
answer_a: Rekoɗi
answer_b: Hasashe
answer_c: Kwatance
answer_d: gwaji

question: Malamin Ajin 6 ya tantance alamar mai nuni da "Gane cewa zafi yana gudana daga wani abu mai zafin jiki mafi girma zuwa wani mai zafin jiki mafi ƙaranci" ta hanyar tambaya kamar haka: Me yasa mutane ke amfani da tufafi masu kauri don dumama jiki? Bayan ya karanta amsoshin ɗaliban, Malamin ya gano cewa da yawa sun amsa: "Saboda tufafin yana rage shigar sanyi zuwa jiki." Wace aiki ce daga cikin waɗannan za ta taimaka wa ɗalibai su fahimci yadda zafi ke gudana tsakanin abubuwa?
answer_a: A gudanar da wani gwaji na ayyuka inda ɗalibai, a cikin aji, suka taɓa wani guntun katako, wani guntun ƙarfe, da wani guntun filastik da hannayensu, kuma su rubuta wanda ya ji da sanyi ko zafi sosai. Daga nan, sai su auna kuma su rubuta zafin waɗannan abubuwan don tabbatar da gudunwar zafi
answer_b: Yi wani aikin gwaji inda akwai zubar zafi tsakanin kofuna biyu na ruwa a yanayi daban-daban, yana nuna abin da ke faruwa ga zubarwar lokacin da aka rufe ɗaya daga cikin kofunan da safar ulu ta halitta
answer_c: A gudanar da gwaji ta hanyar sanya kofuna uku masu ruwa a digiri 10°C: ɗaya a rana, ɗaya kusa da mai ƙonawa, kuma na ƙarshe kusa da kofi mai ruwa a digiri 70°C. Bayan haka, a auna lokacin da za su kai digiri 15°C don tabbatar da kwararar zafi.
answer_d: Gudanar da wani aikin gwaji inda za a sanya wani shirgi na ƙarfe da wani shirgi na allumin ga harshen wutar abin ƙonawa, sannan, ta amfani da ma'aunin zafi, a rubuta ma'aunin zafin kowannensu don a tabbatar da gudun zafin.

question: A lokacin wani darasi na aji na takwas game da hanyoyin jigilar salula, yayin da malamin ke bayanin abin da ke faruwa ga jajayen kwayoyin halitta na jini lokacin da aka fallasa su ga ruwa mai yawan sinadarai (hypertonic solution), wani ɗalibi ya tambaya: "Me ke faruwa ga tsirrai idan ba a shayar da su ba har su raɓe?". Wane ne daga cikin bayanan da ke gaba malamin zai iya ba wa ɗaliban, domin ya kiyaye inganci na kimiyya kuma ya yi amfani da yaren da ya dace da matakin karatun da aka ambata?
answer_a: Idan ba a shayar da tsire-tsire ba, ƙwayoyin tsire-tsire suna fara fitar da ruwa zuwa yanayin wajen ƙwayar halitta, yana rage girman ruwan cikin ƙwayar halitta (cytoplasm), wani lamari da aka sani da plasmolysis, wanda ke sa ganyaye su bayyana a kallo kamar sun yi rauni.
answer_b: Lokacin da ba a shayar da tsirrai ba, cikin kwayar halitta yana zama mai karancin ma'adanai dangane da wajen kwayar halittar, yana sa gishiri ya motsa daga matsakaicin ciki na kwayar halitta zuwa matsakaicin waje na kwayar halitta, ta haka yana rage girman ruwan jikin kwayar halitta, wanda ke sa ganyayen su yi laushi.
answer_c: Lokacin da ba a shayar da tsirrai ba, ma'aunin cikin tantanin halitta yana zama mai karfin osmotic fiye da ma'aunin wajen tantanin halitta, saboda haka ruwa yana motsawa daga waje zuwa ciki, yana haifar da babban ramin ajiyar ruwa ya ƙaru a girma kuma fatar tantanin halitta ta rabu da bangon tantanin halitta, wanda ke sanya ganyaye su nuna kamar sun yi laushi.
answer_d: Idan ba a shayar da shuke-shuke ba, matsakaicin waje yana zama mai yawan gishiri, yana sa ruwa ya fita daga cikin tantanin halitta zuwa wajen tantanin halitta, yana rage girman ruwan halitta kuma yana sa babbar vacuole ta tsakiya ta ragu, wanda ke sa fatar tantanin halitta ta rabu da bangon tantanin halitta, hakan na sa ganyen ya bayyana a matsayin wanda ya yi laushi.

question: A cikin rukunin Kwayoyin Halittu da Tsaikon Kariya na Jikin Dan Adam na ajin 7, malami zai gabatar da buri mai zuwa ga ɗalibai: "Bayyana tsarin rigakafin da alluran rigakafi ke haifarwa." Wane ra'ayi ya kamata ɗalibai su fahimta tun da fari domin cimma wannan burin da aka tsara?
answer_a: Kwamfutar kariya mai tuna baya
answer_b: Halayen rigakafi na asali
answer_c: Halayen T lymphocytes
answer_d: Tsarin aiki na makrofajis

question: A aji na takwas, a sashen Tsarin Kwayar Halitta, wata malama tana koyar da abun ciki game da tsarin atom. Don ta tabbatar ko ɗaliban sun fahimci bambancin da ke tsakanin lambar atom da lambar nauyi, ta nemi su nuna adadin protons, electrons, da neutrons a cikin aluminum mai tsaka-tsarki, idan aka yi la’akari da cewa lambar nauyinsa 27 ce, kuma lambar atom dinsa 13 ce. Ɗalibai da yawa sun nuna kamar haka: Aluminum yana da electrons 27, protons 13, da kuma neutrons 14. Wace matsala ce ɗalibai ke nunawa a cikin tsarin koyonsu da ke da alaƙa da wannan abun ciki?
answer_a: Yardawa cewa adadin electrons daidai yake da jimlar protons da neutrons
answer_b: Ban gane cewa lambar zarra ta yi daidai da adadin cajin da ke da inganci ba.
answer_c: Yin imani da cewa lambar nauyi ta yi daidai da jimlar cajoji masu inganci da cajoji marasa inganci
answer_d: Ba tare da an gane cewa lambar taro daidai take da jimlar zarra’i a cikin nukiliya ba

question: Malami na aji bakwai ya kafa maƙasudi mai zuwa ga ajinsu: “Ku bayyana halayen iska dangane da dokar Boyle.” Waɗanne ilimin da aka riga aka koya dole ne ɗalibai su ƙware a kansu don su fahimci wannan abun ciki?
answer_a: Siffofin abu
answer_b: Makamashi mai motsi na gas
answer_c: Ka'idar Zarra ta Abubuwa
answer_d: Rumbunan ka'idar kuzo-kwayar gasai

question: A ƙarshen darasin Doka ta Boyle a cikin ajin aji na 7, malam/malamar yana buƙatar tantance manuniya ta koyo mai zuwa: "Gane dangantakar da aka kafa tsakanin abubuwa mabambanta a cikin Dokar Boyle." Wane aiki ne zai ba wannan malami damar tattara shaida game da cimma wannan manuniyar koyon?
answer_a: Ku tambayi ɗalibai su bayyana yadda tukunyar matsi take aiki
answer_b: Ku umarci ɗalibai su bayyana yadda injin balan-balan mai zafi yake aiki
answer_c: Ku umarci ɗalibai su ƙididdige jimillar girman iskar gas ɗin da ke cikin wani wuri a tsayi daban-daban
answer_d: Nemi ɗalibai su bayyana canjin girman da kumfa ke fuskanta yayin da take tashi daga kasan tafkin ruwa

question: Wata malamar makarantar sakandare ta aji na uku tana bayyanawa ɗalibai halayen tsarin kwayar jijiya (neuron) a wajen watsa siginar jijiya. Lokacin da ta ambata cewa ana watsa siginar jijiya da sauri a cikin axons masu diamita mafi girma, wata ɗaliba ta ce bata fahimci bayanin nata ba. Malamar ta yanke shawarar yin amfani da wata hanya ta wakilci dabam. Wacece a cikin hanyoyin gabatar da abun koyarwa na gaba zata ba malamar damar bayyana daidai dalilin da yasa axons masu diamita mafi girma ke watsa siginar jijiya da sauri?
answer_a: Ku samar da tebur da ke nuna gudun jigilar bayanai (conduction speeds) a cikin axons na jijiyoyin jiki (neuron axons) na dabbobi masu shayarwa (mammalian) masu diamita daban-daban, ta yadda za su iya kwatanta bambance-bambancen gudun jigilar.
answer_b: Nuna wani motsi mai hoto da ke nuna cewa lokacin da aka zuba ruwa mai kima iri ɗaya a cikin bututu guda biyu masu tsawon iri ɗaya amma faɗinsu ya bambanta, ruwan zai ɗauki ɗan lokaci kaɗan don isa ɗayan ƙarshen a cikin bututun da ya fi faɗi.
answer_c: Nuna hoton zarar jijiya masu girma daban-daban, da mai myelin da kuma waɗanda ba su da shi, yana nuna wuraren depolarization tare da tashoshin ion da ke shiga ciki da kuma rarrabuwar caji kafin, lokacin, da kuma bayan isowar action potential
answer_d: Yi amfani da misalin igiyar lantarki, don bayyana cewa robar da ke rufe igiyoyin tana aiki kamar myelin ɗin da ke kan axons ɗin neuron, wanda ke ƙara saurin tafiyar da siginar wutar lantarki

question: Malami yana buƙatar yin aiki da manufar koyarwa mai biyo baya tare da ɗaliban aji na biyu na makarantar sakandare: “Ƙirƙiri bayanin kimiyya, bisa ga shaidu, game da matakan gadon halittu a cikin dabbobi”. Wanne daga cikin waɗannan ayyukan ne zai ba shi damar cimma wannan manufa?
answer_a: Bisa ga zane-zanen zuriyya na iyalai masu cututtuka daban-daban, ɗalibai suna kwatanta su kuma suna binciken dalilin kowanne
answer_b: Bisa ga shajarorin cututtukan autosomal daban-daban, ɗalibai suna nazarin su kuma suna gano salon gadon kowannensu
answer_c: Ɗaliban sun ƙirƙiro teburi mai ɗauke da halayen gado na dabbobi, kuma su kwatanta hanyoyin da kowace siffa take bayyana.
answer_d: Dalibai sun kirkiri taswirar zuriya da rukunonin jini na abokan karatunsu da iyalansu, kuma sun bayar da bayani kan yadda ake gadonsu

question: Malamin ajin aji na 12 ya nemi ɗaliban da su haɗa gurbatar muhalli da ruwan sama mai tsami. Wacece daga cikin ayyukan da ke gaba ya kamata su yi don dacewa da binciken kimiyya?
answer_a: Yi binciken littattafai game da alakar dake tsakanin ruwan sama mai tsafta (acid rain) da gurbatar muhalli
answer_b: Shirya tambaya wacce take la'akari da alakar da ke tsakanin ruwan sama mai guba (acid rain) da gurbatar muhalli sannan a amsa ta ta hanyar gwaji (experiment)
answer_c: Gudanar da aikin dakin gwaje-gwaje mai amfani da ke nuna alakar gurbatar muhalli da ruwan sama mai tsami
answer_d: Nuna tasirin ruwan sama mai tsafta (acid rain) a kan ciyayi ta hanyar aikatawa/gwaji

question: Malami ya bukaci ɗalibai su gudanar da tsarin gwajin da ke biyo baya, da manufar su nuna hanyoyin safara mara kuzari (passive transport) na abubuwa masu narkewa (solutes) da abubuwan narke su (solvents) ta cikin wani bargo: 1. Ƙara narkarar sukari mai kauri a cikin wata jaka mai izinin wucewa. 2. Sa jakar a cikin akwati mai ɗauke da narkarar sukari da ke da kauri ƙasa da na jakar. 3. Lura da abin da zai faru bayan ƴan mintuna. Wace nakasu samfurin da malamin ya tsara yake da ita dangane da manufar da aka bayyana?
answer_a: Tsarin samfurin bai ƙyale a nuna motsi na abu mai narkewa ba
answer_b: Samfurin kawai yana ba da damar motsin ruwa
answer_c: Samfurin baya nuna motsin ruwa bisa bambancin taro
answer_d: Samfurin ba ya ba da damar wakiltar motsin ƙwayoyi gaba da mizanin tarawa

question: Malamin ajin farko na makarantar sakandare, a lokacin wani darasi kan matsalolin muhalli, dole ne ya tantance manufa mai zuwa: "Fahimtar illolin da sakin sinadarai (chemical agents) ke haifarwa a kan raguwar garkuwar Ozon." Wace irin aiki ce za ta bai wa malamin damar tattara shaida game da cimma manufar da aka gabatar?
answer_a: Bukataci ɗalibai su fitar da abin dubawa daga teburin da ke nuna yawan sinadarin CFCs (chlorofluorocarbons) a sararin samaniya (stratosphere) da kuma yawan kwayoyin halittar ozon a wurin.
